blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built only from the monthly MLS® figures (SnapStats) for houses in White Rock. No local notes, sold prices, building list or live listing feed yet; see the open items.

White Rock, South Surrey and White Rock: 131 houses listed at the end of October 2026 and 12 sold in the month, a sales ratio of 9%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market. By listings that is number 1 of 9 South Surrey and White Rock communities for houses.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. Shares are this community’s count divided by the South Surrey and White Rock total for houses that month.

blocks.text: Listings of houses in White Rock fell from 155 in June to 131 in October (−15.5%), and 49 sold across the 5 months. In October the community held 23.0% of South Surrey and White Rock’s 570 houses listed.
Houses or condos and townhomes in White Rock?
White Rock also had 189 condos and townhomes listed and 22 sold in October, against 131 houses listed.

blocks.text: White Rock home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

85 houses sold in White Rock with a median price of $1,565,000 (the middle half sold between $1,325,000 and $2,030,000), taking a median of 37 days to sell at 95.6% of the last list price; 6% sold above list. They had a median $599 per square foot, a median year built of 1987 and a median lot of 5,165 square feet.

faq.q: How many houses are for sale in White Rock?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board figures showed 131 houses listed in White Rock. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is White Rock a buyers’ or sellers’ market for houses?
faq.a: In October 2026, houses in White Rock had a sales ratio of 9%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many houses sold in White Rock from June to October 2026?
faq.a: 49 houses sold in White Rock over those 5 months, out of 294 in all of South Surrey and White Rock.

faq.q: Does this page include townhomes or duplexes in White Rock?
faq.a: No. The figures are for detached houses only. Condos and townhomes are counted on their own page.

faq.q: What did houses in White Rock sell for?
faq.a: 85 houses sold in White Rock between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $1,565,000.

faq.q: How long do houses take to sell in White Rock?
faq.a: The median was 37 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 95.6% of the last list price (6% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
